article.title: Kling Image 4.0加入多圖集及長版素材生成
article.title_en: Kling Image 4.0 adds image sets and long-form visuals
article.summary: Kling AI推出Image 4.0，在Creative Studio及API提供圖像生成，支援同一提示製作圖集與長版素材。
article.summary_en: Kling AI introduced Image 4.0 in Creative Studio and the API, including coordinated sets and long-form image generation.
highlights: 單次提示可生成最多10張圖，並按同一創意方向安排各圖重點。
平台可直接修改生成圖內的文字及字體，適合逐步修訂版面。
highlights_en: One prompt can generate up to10 images organized around a creative direction.
Users can edit text and fonts within platform-generated images.
article.why: 商品展示可由逐張製作改為先規劃整組素材，創意團隊可決定哪些畫面共用主題，哪些需要獨立突出產品細節。
article.why_en: Creative teams can plan a complete product set, deciding which frames share a theme and which emphasize separate details.
article.next_step: 以同一產品建立一組主視覺、功能圖及情境圖，逐張核對包裝、文字和色彩，再決定哪些圖需要重做。
article.next_step_en: Create hero, feature and lifestyle images for one product and review packaging, copy and color in each.
article.detail: 官方11月18日文章亦列出原生8K輸出及長版商品頁圖像。這些是模型規格與功能描述，實際可讀性及產品細節仍需逐張覆查。團隊可先把每張圖的用途和必須保留的資訊列清楚，再比較圖集是否沿用一致的產品外觀與視覺方向，最後才安排不同版位的輸出。公告列明支援繁簡中文等七種語言。
article.detail_en: The November 18 official article also lists native 8K and long product-page visuals. These are product specifications rather than verified output quality. Define every frame's purpose and required information, then compare product appearance and art direction before preparing placement variants. The company lists seven languages, including Traditional and Simplified Chinese.
